bitcoin_business_accounting_guide: Kasamalidwe ka Bitcoin pa bizinesi yanu
accounting_description: Gaidi yosavuta yolandirira Bitcoin m'mabuku anu — zikwama za hybrid, mtengo wapakhomo, capital gains, ndi pamene muyenera kuyimbira owerenga ndalama.
accounting_hero_subtitle: Kulandira Bitcoin m'bizinesi yanu sikuyenera kupangitsa kasamalidwe ka ndalama kuti kakhale kovuta. Apa pali baibulo losavuta ndi zida ndi akatswiri omwe amapangitsa kukhala kotetezeka.
accounting_intro_c1: Ngati mukulandira ndalama zenizeni kapena makhadi kale, kuonjezera Bitcoin m'mabuku anu kuli kosavuta kuposa momwe mukuganizira. Pali njira ziwiri — sinthani malipiro a Bitcoin kukhala dola mwadzidzidzi (palibe kasamalidwe katsopano), kapena sungani ena ngati Bitcoin (kuwonjezera mbali zochepa).
accounting_intro_c2: Gaidi iyi ikuthandizirani njira zonse ziwiri — sankhani njira yomwe ikugwirizana ndi bizinesi yanu ndipo yambani kulandira Bitcoin.
accounting_disclaimer: Gaidi iyi ndi ya zidziwitso zokhazo ndipo siyiyenera kuonedwa ngati malangizo a misonkho. Pa malangizo a misonkho a vuto lanu, pemphani upangiri wa woweregera ndalama woyenerera.
accounting_s1: Njira yosavuta — kusintha kukhala dola mwadzidzidzi
accounting_s1_c1: Njira yosavuta yolandirira Bitcoin ndi chikwama cha hybrid chomwe chimagulitsa 100% ya Bitcoin yomwe mwalandira kukhala madola (kapena ndalama yanu yakuderali) mwadzidzidzi.
accounting_s1_c2: Ndi kasitomu uyu, mabuku anu adzawoneka chimodzimodzi ndi momwe akuwoneka lero — nambala yomaliza ili m'madola, nthawi iliyonse. Palibe mtengo wapakhomo, palibe phindu lakukwera, palibe mapepala atsopano.
accounting_card_wallets_title: Onani zikwama za bizinesi zomwe timalimbikitsa
accounting_s2: Ngati musunga Bitcoin ena: kutsata mtengo wapakhomo wanu
accounting_s2_c1: Mabizinesi ena amasankha kusunga gawo la Bitcoin yomwe alandira m'malo mosintha zonse mwadzidzidzi. Ngati ndi inu, sitepe yowonjezera ndi kulemba mtengo wapakhomo wanu — mtengo wa dola wa tsiku lomwe Bitcoin idalandiridwa.
accounting_s2_c2: Ngakhale mukuganiza za bizinesi yanu m'Bitcoin, akuluakulu a misonkho amafuna kuti mtengo wa dola udziwike. Nkhani yabwino — nambala ziwiri zokha pa malonda aliwonse — kuchuluka kwa Bitcoin yolandiridwa ndi mtengo wake wa dola pa tsikulo.
accounting_s2_c3: Gwiritsani ntchito zida zomwe zili pansi pa kupanga kafukufuku mwadzidzidzi kuti musayese kufufuza mitengo tsiku ndi tsiku.
accounting_card_bpr_title: Pezani mtengo wapano kapena wakale wa dola wa Bitcoin
accounting_card_spreadsheet_title: Lowetsani mitengo ya Bitcoin mu Excel mwadzidzidzi
accounting_s3: Kugwiritsa ntchito kapena kugulitsa Bitcoin yomwe mwasunga
accounting_s3_c1: Ngati mukusintha malipiro aliwonse kukhala madola mwadzidzidzi, dumphani gawoli — silikukukhudzani.
accounting_s3_c2: Ngati mwasunga Bitcoin ena ndipo pambuyo pake mwasankha kuyigwiritsa ntchito kapena kuyigulitsa, wonjezerani mtengo wakugulitsa pa spreadsheet yomweyo ya mtengo wapakhomo. Kusiyana pakati pa mtengo wolandirira ndi mtengo wakugwiritsa/kugulitsa ndi phindu lakukwera kapena kutaya kwanu.
accounting_s3_c6: Ndi zomwezo. Masamu apansi ndi ofanana ndi momwe katundu aliyense wokwera mtengo kapena wotsika mtengo amalembedwa.
accounting_s4_c1: Ngati mukufuna kupereka ntchitoyi — kapena kasamalidwe kanu ka Bitcoin ndi kovuta kuposa momwe chikwama cha hybrid chingathandizire — timalimbikitsa kwambiri Satoshi Pacioli Accounting Services, omwe amayang'anira kasamalidwe ka Bitcoin ka mabizinesi.
